inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada is tightening immigration and asylum rules for Nigerians and others after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. A country has a duty to protect its borders and preserve public order; stronger rules are a necessary step toward restoring control over who enters and stays.
